title: Todd Zeiter, TDC Chief Underwriting Officer, Named R&I Executive to Watch
summary: This annual recognition celebrates a select group of insurance carrier executives helping to shape the future of the industry.
body_markdown:
This annual recognition celebrates a select group of insurance carrier executives helping to shape the future of the industry.


Todd has more than 35 years of experience in medical professional liability insurance in underwriting, reinsurance, and strategic leadership. His work has played a key role in advancing underwriting practices and navigating complex risks.


You can read the full article[here](https://riskandinsurance.com/the-2027-executives-to-watch-the-doctors-companys-todd-zeiter/) .
